title: Playing at the Lyric with Dan Hughes and Lou Rose; left-handed guitar
summary: He played at the Lyric with Dan Hughes and for Lou Rose, and played a left-handed guitar strung right-handed.

story.theme_name: Banjo, guitar and the rhythm section: instruments and players
story.community_name: Banjo, guitar and the rhythm section's changing role

blocks.x: You're saying Dan Hughes played at the Lyric, huh?
And you were there with him, huh?
Yeah. Played for Lou Rose. Remember Lou Rose?
Oh, yeah, that's right. Wasn't he the one who wanted to take you away?
No, uh-uh. Somebody else wanted to take it away.
Was you? And you strung it like a right-handed?
And you had to hit... How would you hit? In an upstroke? Oh, yeah. Lou Rose, huh? He had that chill.
Yeah. What is that? Cut the mouth and... And... Cut the mouth and...
